## Description

Configure Microsoft Entra-only authentication on the logical server. The App Service managed identity is the only application principal. Create one database user/role per module schema (identity, tenancy, audit, … ) with GRANT only on its own schema, a separate migration principal with DDL rights, and a read-only reporting role. Connection strings use `Authentication=Active Directory Managed Identity; Encrypt=Strict`. No SQL logins with passwords exist.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Attempting SQL authentication with a username/password fails (Entra-only is on).
- [ ] **AC2.** The app identity cannot ALTER/CREATE objects; the migration identity can; verified by integration test against Testcontainers SQL Server using equivalent roles.
- [ ] **AC3.** A module's database role cannot SELECT from another module's schema (architecture/integration test).
- [ ] **AC4.** Connection strings in App Service settings contain no password; `Encrypt=Strict` is enforced.
- [ ] **AC5.** Human access to production data is only via just-in-time elevation (documented runbook, links MDV-P0-025).

## Definition of Done
